item.text: I’m keeping the refactor inside the same completion pipeline. The next useful boundary is the proposal-collection flow itself, which is still partly embedded in the LSP adapter instead of living in the SQL model layer.

I’m editing the proposal-collection boundary now. The goal is to make the LSP adapter just a transport layer and move the SQL-engine orchestration into `model.sql`, where the analyzer support and engine-decision logic already live.

The LSP adapter is now thin, so I’m adding one direct provider test for the new shared proposal-collection service. That gives the extraction a concrete check instead of relying only on older analyzer tests.
I caught a compile issue in the new test immediately: it was reaching into another test’s private helper. I’m flattening that now so the provider test is self-contained.
The provider test is now self-contained. I’m doing the final static pass over the new shared proposal provider and both tests before I close this out.
The static pass is clean. I’m grabbing the final diff summary and git state, then I’ll close with the design change and the same runtime verification limitation as before.

I pushed the proposal-collection flow down into the SQL model layer with [SQLCompletionProposalProvider.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.sql/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/SQLCompletionProposalProvider.java:1). That class now owns engine selection, semantic-context wiring, and legacy fallback collection, so the LSP adapter no longer contains SQL-specific orchestration logic.

As a result, [LspSQLCompletionContextParser.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/plugins/org.jkiss.dbeaver.model.lsp/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/lsp/context/LspSQLCompletionContextParser.java:1) is mostly just request creation plus `CompletionItem` mapping. I also added a direct provider test in [SQLCompletionProposalProviderTest.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/G001_dbeaver/test/org.jkiss.dbeaver.test.platform/src/org/jkiss/dbeaver/model/sql/completion/SQLCompletionProposalProviderTest.java:1) so the new shared service has explicit coverage.
